links.outcome: Resident glaucoma progression rating error, confidence, and reaction time with versus without AI forecasts
links.effect: Global MAE showed minor differences with vs without AI forecasts; heterogeneous patient-specific impacts; residents more conservative and more confident with AI; reaction times comparable.
links.quote: Globally, MAE for GP ratings with and without AI forecasts show minor differences.

screen.reason: Empirical reader/user study testing the impact of AI-assisted visual field forecasting on resident clinician decision-making, confidence, and reaction time compared to unassisted assessment.

primary.practice: AI-assisted visual field forecasting decision support
